India objects to UN rapporteur's counter-terror report, Dawood Ibrahim mention

India has lodged a protest against a United Nations counter-terrorism report, objecting to its alleged bias and a specific mention of Dawood Ibrahim. The Indian government stated that the report falsely projected Dawood Ibrahim as 'India-based'. India affirmed that Dawood Ibrahim is located in Pakistan.
